newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony to provide products, knowhow to NBC, TVRS 98.
newsitem.headline: Sony to provide products, knowhow to NBC, TVRS 98.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Tuesday it would provide products and technology to NBC of the United States for its coverage of future Olympic Games, and to France's TVRS 98 for its coverage of soccer's 1998 World Cup.

Sony's U.S. unit Sony Electronics Inc said it would provide products and would design and assemble equipment for NBC at the International Broadcast Centre at the 2000, 2002, 2004, 2006 and 2008 Olympic Games.
NBC is a unit of General Electric Co.
Sony's British unit Sony Broadcast and Professional Europe said it would provide TVRS 98 with its Betacam SX and Digital Betacam VTRs to deliver international audio and video programming.
TVRS 98 is a joint venture of TF1, Canal Plus, France 2, France 3, Radio France, Radio France Internationale and TDF.
A Sony spokesman declined to give the value of the contracts. No further details were immediately available, he added.
